name: Enterprise AI approved-tools inventory
what: A read-first method to build and maintain the approved / conditional / denied inventory for Microsoft Copilot and third-party enterprise LLMs, with identity, retention and data-class fields an auditor can check.
when: Before the first multi-vendor AI pilot, during shadow-AI discovery, or when renewing AI contracts. Documentation-verified method; not lab-tested.
cost_note: The inventory method is free. Discovery tooling (Defender for Cloud Apps, Purview DSPM for AI, SWG logs) and enterprise AI licences are separate paid services.
example: Create a private inventory (change/Grc system, not a public wiki) with columns: tool, vendor SKU (Enterprise vs consumer), IdP/SSO, Entra app ID, Conditional Access coverage, allowed data classifications, residency/inference region, retention or ZDR notes, training stance, audit/export path, DPA status, business owner, security review date, exception expiry.

Seed Microsoft Copilot / Copilot Chat / Copilot Studio, then any ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise or Grok enterprise contracts. Mark consumer ChatGPT, consumer Copilot and personal Grok as Denied for company data.
Run Defender for Cloud Apps / Shadow IT discovery for the Generative AI category and Purview DSPM for AI insights. Triage each discovered app into Approve / Conditional / Block with an owner.
For each Approve candidate, capture the primary vendor privacy/admin URL for training and retention (do not paste marketing claims). Confirm SSO is enforceable before inviting seats.
Publish a short employee-facing approved list linked from the AI use policy. Schedule a 90-day re-review. Store exceptions with expiry and compensating controls.
Keep API keys, IDE assistants and agent platforms in the same inventory as chat UIs — separate rows when retention/ZDR rules differ from the chat product.
pitfalls: Mixing consumer and Enterprise SKUs in one row hides the control gap.
An inventory without review dates becomes shelfware; discovery without an approved alternative drives shadow use onto personal phones.
Keep this method documentation-led until change owners approve pilots; do not enable production connectors to 'test' the spreadsheet.
